capabilities: Encrypt selected or typed text into age-encrypted inline tokens or fenced blocks
Reveal, copy, and relock decrypted secrets in Reading mode and Live Preview
Encrypt attachment files to .age sidecars and preview or save decrypted copies
Encrypt scalar values in secure-properties blocks while keeping keys readable
Re-encrypt vault secrets after adding or removing age recipients
extras: README warns that lost keys or passphrases mean unrecoverable ciphertext and to keep private key files outside the synced vault. Describes a security boundary section noting clipboard managers, sync tools, and editor history can still expose revealed plaintext. Includes manual install instructions from the repository.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to store secrets as ciphertext inside notes, so sensitive values sit in plaintext in the vault.

relations.evidence: Keep interoperability with the age CLI.

summary: Encryption plugin that encrypts selected text, typed plaintext, property values, and attachments in notes using age encryption, revealed on click.
